prompt: Create a polished high-fidelity WEBSITE SCREEN COMP, not a poster and not a photograph. Desktop landscape 1440x1000, Thai-language university VR equipment checkout admin dashboard. Direction: a contemporary campus equipment circulation ledger. Warm ivory uncoated stock background, dark ink typography, restrained muted forest green as primary action ink; semantic status stamps stay unmistakable: pale yellow pending approval, clear red borrowed, quiet grey damaged, green ready. Crisp ruled ledger rows and printed index tabs are the material system, not paper grain or photo texture. One compact horizontal institutional wordmark header, a clear admin navigation line of tab-like printed index labels, then a page title “ภาพรวมอุปกรณ์ VR” and understated action “สแกนรับคืน”. Dashboard first screen: compact summary counts; the dominant region is an ordered approval register at top with 3 concise pending loan records showing time, student name, device code and adjacent review / approve actions; below it begins an equipment inventory register with device number, smaller QR code, readable status and recent borrower. Use real legible Thai UI text, compact tabular numerals, strong whitespace, square geometry with subtle 8–12px corners, 1px rules, no big rounded cards, no shadows. Clearly reads as an operational interface in under a second. Keep real interface controls and usable density; no decorative illustration, no generic icon-card grid, no gradients, no overly large hero, no noise. Use only plausible example labels such as VR-014; mark fictional data ‘ข้อมูลตัวอย่าง’. Focus composition on a clear approval queue above inventory, print-like aligned columns. This is proposal A: a continuous ledger table with approval rows across the whole page, minimal device tiles below.
